Provincial Councils Notifications
NORTH CENTRAL PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor of North Central Provincial Council

By virtue of the power vested in me, under section 32(a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, I Punchi BandaDissanayaka, the Governor of the North Central Province, do hereby notify that the officers, names mentioned below havebeen appointed for the posts North Central Provincial Council Services.
01. Mr. S. M. S. Bandulasena, Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of the Ministry of
the Provincial Health, Ayurvedic, Social Welfare Services, Probation and child care services and Provincial Affairs witheffect from 22.03.2017 until further an order is made.
02. Mr. W. A. R. Wimalasiri, Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as Deputy Chief Secretary (Personnel
and Training) of North Central Provincial Council with effect from the date 07.04.2017 to 27.08.2017.
03. Mr. H. M. Thilaka Bandara, Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Deputy Chief Secretary
(Personnel and Training) of North Central Provincial Council with effect from 28.08.2017 until further an order is made.
04. Mr. W. A. R. Wimalasiri, Officer in special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of the Public Service
Commission of North Central Provincial Council with effect from 28.08.2017 until further an order is made.
05. Mrs. W. T. A. Manel, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the Chief Secretary of North
Central Provincial Council with effect from 29.09.2015.
06. Mr. S. S. M. S. R. Dharmadasa, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Land Commissioner North
Central Provincial Council with effect from 22.06.2017 until further an order is made.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

post for acting as the Director of the Industrial Development of the North Central Provincial Council with effect from03.07.2017 (to fulfill the duties from 13.05.2017 to 02.07.2017)
09. Mr. G. K. S. Pushpa Kumara, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service to perform the duties as the Director
of Sport of the North Central Province for the duration of 13.03.2017 to 11.06.2017.
10. Mr. E. P. G. C. K. Madugalla, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the director of social
service of the North Central Provincial Council with effect from 22.08.2017 until further an order is made.
11. Mrs. K. D. Aruna Shantha, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service to perform duties as the Director of
Culture of the North Central Province with effect from 30.11.2015.
12. Mr. Kelum Dissanayaka, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of the permanent

13. Mr. J. L. M. G. S. S. L. M. Weerasinghe, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service in addition to the duties of
the permanent post for acting as the Secretary of the Cooperative Employees Commission from 26.04.2017.
14. Mr. P. M. Nalin Chaminda, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Accountant service as the Chief Internal Auditor of the Internal
Audit and Investigation Department of the North Central Council with effect from 26.04.2017until further an order is made.
15. Mr. G. Karawita, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Animal Product and Health service for acting as the Director of Animal
Production and Health with effect from 21.09.2017 until further an order is made.
16. Mr. R. S. Samaranayaka, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service as the Commissioner of Revenue of the
North Central Province for the durations of 06.03.2017 to 05.09.2017, 06.09.2017 to 05.03.2018 and 06.03.2018 to 05.06.2018on contract basis.
P. B. DISSANAYAKA, Governor of the North Central Provincial Council.
At the Governor's Office of the North Central Provincial Council,14th of March 2018.
